preconditions.description: The length of the ciphered text n must be between 1 and 10,000.
The length of the ciphered text t must equal n.
The number of words m must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(wi) <= 1000 for wi in words)
preconditions.description: Each word wi must have a length between 1 and 1,000.
The total length of all words must not exceed 1,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be a valid sentence composed of words from the list, separated by spaces.

postconditions.expression: all(wi in words for wi in original_sentence)
postconditions.description: All words in the output sentence must be from the provided list of words.
The total length of the words in the output sentence, when concatenated, must equal the length of the ciphered text.
